classifications.authority_or_basis: USDKG official material identifies OJSC Virtual Asset Issuer as a state-owned issuer under the Kyrgyz Ministry of Finance and describes USDKG as a gold-backed virtual asset; registry v3 leaves the legal classification unclassified rather than inventing a fiat-stablecoin category.

notes: State-owned issuer and gold backing are established; exact holder legal claim, reserve ownership, segregation and insolvency treatment remain unresolved.
